loop: OBSERVE: collect all quality reports and runtime evidence
DIAGNOSE: map every lost point to a concrete missing control/evidence
PRIORITIZE: rank improvements by impact × confidence × reuse ÷ effort × risk
PLAN: generate concrete tasks with files/tests/acceptance criteria
PROPAGATE: prefer one canonical fix shared across compatible projects
VERIFY: run regression, project, technology, contract, device and visual gates
LEARN: confirmed fixes become protected errors; approved successes become Golden
PROMOTE: baseline may move upward only after all gates pass
automaticActionsForbiddenWithoutVerified: claiming a runtime technology is integrated
silently deleting a protected regression rule
